seoTitle: How to Integrate Gokwik with Shopify Easily
metaDescription: Set up Gokwik's KwikCheckout app on Shopify for one-click checkout, pre-filled addresses, and smart COD verification to reduce RTO.
intro: For Indian D2C brands dealing with high return-to-origin rates on cash-on-delivery orders, Gokwik's KwikCheckout app offers a way to streamline checkout and filter risky orders. This guide covers installing the app, connecting your merchant account, and configuring COD verification and one-click checkout.

steps.heading: Install the Gokwik KwikCheckout app
steps.body: Add the app to your Shopify store from the Shopify App Store.

steps.heading: Review the merchant dashboard
steps.body: Log into your Gokwik merchant account to familiarize yourself with the dashboard.

steps.heading: Activate one-click checkout
steps.body: Turn on the one-click checkout feature to speed up the customer purchase flow.

steps.heading: Set up COD verification rules
steps.body: Configure smart COD rules to block high-risk return-to-origin orders.

steps.heading: Customize the checkout appearance
steps.body: Adjust the checkout UI to match your brand colors and logo.

steps.heading: Test the live checkout flow
steps.body: Run through a test purchase to confirm the checkout process works as expected before going live.

faq.question: How does Gokwik help reduce RTO?
faq.answer: Gokwik's smart COD verification rules are designed to flag and block high-risk orders that are more likely to result in return-to-origin.

faq.question: Can I customize how the checkout looks?
faq.answer: Yes, the checkout UI can be customized with your brand colors and logo to keep it consistent with your store.

faq.question: Is Gokwik designed specifically for Indian merchants?
faq.answer: Yes, the integration is aimed at Indian e-commerce businesses dealing with cash-on-delivery orders and local shipping challenges.

faq.question: Does this replace Shopify's default checkout entirely?
faq.answer: It's designed to enhance the checkout experience with features like one-click checkout and pre-filled addresses, layered on top of your Shopify store.
